prs.title: feat(playground): allow a custom runtime helper module name
prs.author: Dunqing
prs.body:
Expose `TransformOptions.helper_loader.module_name` as `helperModuleName`, so the playground can emit helper imports from a URL such as a versioned esm.sh package that a browser can load directly.

Companion UI: https://github.com/oxc-project/playground/pull/478

Verified with `cargo check -p oxc_playground_napi`, `cargo fmt --check`, and clippy.

prs.title: feat(lexer): publish lexer and SIMD crates
prs.author: Boshen
prs.body:
Enable standalone use of `oxc_lexer` by publishing it and its SIMD dependencies. Remove the dependency on an unpublished helper so the initial releases build against crates.io.

AI-assisted with Codex.

prs.title: fix(linter/import/no-duplicates): ignore braces in module strings
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Duplicate imports such as `import '}{'; import '}{';` panic during ordinary linting because the merge fix treats braces in the module string as specifier delimiters, even when fixes are disabled.

Bound delimiter searches to the text before the module string, select the outer brace pair with the existing forward/reverse helpers, and require ordered positions before slicing. Add regressions for ordinary linting and autofixes, including empty/default imports and braces in string-named specifiers and comments.

prs.title: fix(linter/eslint/no-empty): use byte offsets for finally suggestions
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Suggestion fixing for an empty `finally` could panic when earlier source contained multibyte characters: the keyword search mixed byte offsets with character indices. Scan backward with `char_indices()` over the source before the finalizer so deletion ranges use actual byte offsets.

Skip suggestions when the matched text is inside a comment or removing `finally` would leave a `try` without a handler. Regression cases cover the reported crash input, Unicode whitespace, and comment boundaries.

prs.title: docs(napi/parser): correct TS-ESTree differences
fix(linter/no-large-snapshots): avoid panics on Unicode whitespace
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Jest and Vitest `no-large-snapshots` panic when a snapshot argument is followed by multibyte whitespace, such as U+00A0. Line counting treats the exclusive span end as inclusive and slices into the following UTF-8 character.

Use the exclusive range and add regressions for Unicode whitespace after string and template snapshots in both plugins.

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/prefer-array-flat): avoid panic on rest parameters
prs.author: camc314
prs.body: Skip `reduce` callbacks with rest parameters and require exactly two ordinary parameters before inspecting their binding patterns. This prevents `array.reduce((a, ...b) => a.concat(b), [])` from panicking, with regression coverage for both concat and spread callback bodies.

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/no-document-cookie): stop resolving cyclic aliases
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Inputs such as `var a = a; a.cookie = 0;` cause unbounded recursion while `unicorn/no-document-cookie` follows variable initializers.

Resolve aliases iteratively with a visited-symbol set and stop when a symbol repeats. Add regressions for self-reference, mutual cycles, aliases leading into cycles, and valid alias chains across shadowed bindings.

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/prefer-set-has): avoid panics on Unicode whitespace
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Unicode whitespace between `new` and `Array` could cause the fixer to slice inside a UTF-8 character and panic even when autofix was disabled.

Wrap the complete initializer in `new Set(...)` using its AST span. This preserves whitespace, comments, escaped identifiers, and constructor syntax. Regression tests cover diagnostics and fixed output, including `new Array` without parentheses.

prs.title: fix(linter/typescript/consistent-type-imports): avoid panic on quoted import names
prs.author: camc314

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/no-useless-spread): avoid panics on Unicode whitespace
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
A sequence such as `[...( 0, [])]` (U+00A0 before `0`) can panic during diagnostic construction, even with fixes disabled. Expanding its span by one byte splits the whitespace's UTF-8 encoding.

Use the original expression span for the snippet and add regressions for two- and three-byte whitespace in array and object spreads, including autofixes.

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/no-length-as-slice-end): avoid panic on wrapped callees
prs.author: camc314
prs.body: `unicorn/no-length-as-slice-end` panics on valid source such as `(a.slice)(0, a.length)`. Normalize the callee once and reuse the member for matching, receiver comparison, and diagnostic spans so the call reports normally and fixes to `(a.slice)(0)`.

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/prefer-dom-node-remove): avoid panic on parenthesized optional chains
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
`(parentNode?.removeChild)(child)` passes the method-call guard, but the callee-span helper returns `None`, causing an `unwrap()` panic.

Skip the diagnostic when that helper returns `None`, matching ESLint/Unicorn, and add regression cases for parenthesized optional chains.

prs.title: fix(formatter_htmlish): keep attrs holding character reference
prs.author: leaysgur
prs.body:
Keep `<button onclick="x=a & b">a</button>` as-is.

If this is written in `.js`, it's just `x = a & amp; b;`. But in `.html` attribute, it should be kept and leave it to browser.

fix(formatter): align union hug and conditional branch
prs.author: leaysgur
prs.body:
- A single-line block comment right before a hugged union (`X | null`) is the first member's, so the union expands (`| /* c */ X`)
- A line-ending comment before a hugged alias union keeps the hug
- A union in a conditional type's branch prints its first `|` right behind the `?` / `:`
- Record the union style hold's scope, the hug and comment table, and two open debts in AGENTS.md and DIVERGENCES.md

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/prefer-object-from-entries): avoid panic on wrapped callees
prs.author: camc314
prs.body: `(x.reduce)(0, 0);` panics because `is_method_call` unwraps the callee while the rule casts the original expression. Inspect the normalized member expression to avoid the panic and preserve optional-call exclusions. Add regression coverage for parenthesized, computed, and TypeScript-wrapped callees.

prs.title: fix(linter/unicorn/prefer-includes): avoid panic on parenthesized optional chains
prs.author: camc314
prs.body: `(obj?.indexOf)('x') !== -1` passes the method-name check but has no callee metadata, causing `unicorn/prefer-includes` to panic. Return early for these unsupported callees, avoiding suggestions that would change the optional-chain boundary.

prs.title: refactor(formatter): stop union layout decisions depending on cursor
fix(linter/vitest/prefer-called-once): avoid panics on escaped matcher names
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Matchers are recognized by their decoded names, but the rule trimmed `Times` from the raw source span. An escaped Unicode line continuation could therefore put the slice endpoint inside a UTF-8 character and panic during linting, even without autofix.

Use canonical replacement names and preserve the quotes or backticks around computed properties. Add regression coverage for both aliases, Unicode continuations, and escaped matcher spellings.

prs.title: refactor(linter/unicorn/prefer-includes): use let chains
fix(linter/jest/prefer-to-be,linter/vitest/prefer-to-be): avoid Unicode whitespace panics
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Unicode whitespace before computed matchers or `not` modifiers could make `jest/prefer-to-be` and `vitest/prefer-to-be` panic when recommending `toBeNull` or `toBeNaN`.

Locate the opening bracket within the member access with a comment-aware token lookup instead of subtracting a byte from the literal span. Preserve optional member/call operators in autofixes and add regressions for both plugins.

prs.title: fix(linter/oxc/no-accumulating-spread): avoid panic on parenthesized optional chains
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
`is_method_call` recognizes `(arr?.reduce)((acc, x) => [...acc, x], [])`, but diagnostic extraction previously failed to unwrap the optional chain and panicked. Use `get_member_expr()` to extract the method span with a guard, then pass the span to diagnostic creation.

Adds regression coverage for `reduce`/`reduceRight`, computed properties, TypeScript wrappers, and calls that should remain unreported.

prs.title: fix(linter/react/jsx-key): only check direct JSX array elements
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
Limit array key checks to JSX elements and fragments that are direct array members, ignoring parentheses. This matches eslint-plugin-react and avoids reporting conditional tuple entries such as `[value, needed ? <Counter /> : null] as const`. Conditional JSX returned from iterator callbacks still requires a key.

Fixes #29246

fix(linter/unicorn/consistent-template-literal-escape): avoid panics after CRLF
prs.author: camc314
prs.body:
The parser normalizes CRLF in template raw values, so applying offsets from that text to the original source can panic on Unicode even without `--fix`, or corrupt autofixes.

Scan each quasi's original source to keep diagnostic and fix spans aligned. Add regression coverage for line endings, Unicode, backslash parity, and multiple quasis.

prs.title: fix(linter/vitest/require-test-timeout): avoid overflow when sorting configurations
prs.author: camc314
prs.body: Three sequential `vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: ... })` calls can panic in builds with overflow checks enabled because the span comparator subtracts unsigned offsets. Sort by `Reverse(span.end)` instead, preserving the earliest completed configuration for the timeout check, and cover repeated and nested configuration calls.
